Deviations from plan: none material. Two additive ToolCall fields beyond the literal S4 field list (no_result, result_source) were required to carry S6/S2 outcomes per the design doc — both defaulted, backward compatible with TB-2. One mypy --strict fix needed in test fixture dict annotations (dict invariance), no production code impact.

Footgun for downstream tickets: `lattice attach --role` only accepts "review"; other artifact types must omit --role and use `--type note --inline ...` instead (validation/other roles are rejected).

Stopping here per workflow — not merging, not touching other tickets.
